summary: Executed backend pytest and frontend Playwright for auth lockout, CORS preflight layer diagnosis, admin user detail/status authorization, admin users drawer UI, order regressions, storefront search stability, and console runtime checks.

critical.issue: Credentialed preflight still fails at public gateway/ingress with 400 'Disallowed CORS origin' while the same preflight to app-local http://localhost:8001/api/auth/login passes with 200 and correct CORS headers.

integration_issues.issue: Browser console still logs 401 resource errors during unauthenticated / auth-transition states.

action_items: Fix ingress/public-layer handling for credentialed OPTIONS /api/auth/login so configured preview origin is accepted and reflected.
Optionally reduce expected startup/auth-transition 401 console noise for cleaner runtime logs.
critical_code_review_comments: CORS middleware config in app is effective locally, but external behavior diverges; the break appears before/above app middleware (gateway/ingress path).
backend/server.py remains a large monolith (>1600 LOC), increasing regression risk when touching auth/admin/order surfaces.

success_rate.frontend: 96% (all requested UI workflows passed; only console 401 noise observed)

seed_data_creation: Created disposable lockout/suspend/hash-format users; suspended disposable user was restored to active=true in test finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Verified fixes: brute-force lockout now enforces 429 after 5 failed attempts even with valid password; admin user APIs return active flag and sanitized detail shape (user/orders/returns/wallet), non-admin gets 403 on admin user detail/status patch, suspend/activate endpoint blocks suspended user protected access and restore works. Frontend verified: Admin Users page stayed dark even with customer light mode set, drawer shows wallet/address/orders/returns and state control, customer My Orders/detail/invoice and admin order drawer functional, storefront search stayed stable after >3s.
rca of the issue: Reproduction: send OPTIONS /api/auth/login with Origin=https://dashboard-design-20.preview.emergentagent.com and Access-Control-Request-Method=POST. Public preview endpoint returns 400 'Disallowed CORS origin'; direct app-local endpoint http://localhost:8001/api/auth/login returns 200 with access-control-allow-origin and allow-credentials=true. RCA indicates CORS rejection at gateway/ingress layer, not FastAPI app middleware. Mitigation: align ingress CORS allowlist/headers for preview origin and credentialed preflight, then retest same OPTIONS path end-to-end.
